name: io.github.hrabosh/wos-mcp-bridge
title: Web of Science MCP bridge
description: Search Web of Science Core Collection and find open-access literature.

environmentVariables.name: WOS_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Use full for seven tools with a WoS key, or literature for four literature tools.

environmentVariables.name: WOS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Clarivate Starter API key with Core Collection access. Required for the full profile.

environmentVariables.name: OPENALEX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenAlex API key for a higher request budget.
